nodes.summary: Implement STACKIT standalone Terraform module with stackit_kms_keyring and stackit_kms_key resources
Add KMS_ENDPOINT to module.contract.yaml outputs.produced
Add kms_endpoint() returning Vault Transit URL on local lane and STACKIT KMS REST URL on STACKIT lane
Add kms_render_values_file(), kms_reconcile_runtime_secret(), kms_enable_vault_transit() to kms.sh
Update kms_apply.sh: add helm driver case and endpoint key in write_state_file
Update kms_plan.sh: add helm driver case writing plan state on local profile
Update kms_destroy.sh: add helm driver case calling run_helm_uninstall
Harden kms_smoke.sh with non-empty checks for key_ring_id, key_id, and endpoint
Implement variables.tf and outputs.tf for the STACKIT standalone Terraform module
Implement infra/local/helm/kms/values.yaml with Vault dev mode chart values
Update module_execution.sh: change kms local-profile driver from noop to helm
Vault root token must not be stored in plaintext; delivered via K8s Secret only
All four scripts emit metric events via start_script_metric_trap (pre-existing)
lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true } on stackit_kms_keyring; STACKIT destroy semantics follow provider contract
Runtime state must contain 5 contract keys; smoke validates key_ring_id, key_id, endpoint
N/A — infrastructure module with no browser-facing surface
main.tf declares stackit_kms_keyring and stackit_kms_key with lifecycle create_before_destroy
variables.tf declares all required and optional contract inputs
outputs.tf exposes kms_keyring_id, kms_keyring_display_name, kms_key_id, kms_key_display_name
module.contract.yaml outputs.produced includes KMS_ENDPOINT
kms_endpoint() on local lane returns string containing vault, transit, and port 8200
kms_apply.sh write_state_file includes endpoint=$(kms_endpoint)
kms_smoke.sh passes when key_ring_id, key_id, and endpoint are all present and non-empty
kms_smoke.sh fails when key_id is empty or absent
kms_smoke.sh fails when key_ring_id is empty or absent
kms_smoke.sh fails when endpoint is empty or absent
Local lane runtime state fixture has all five contract output keys
infra/local/helm/kms/values.yaml sets fullnameOverride: blueprint-vault and server.dev.enabled: true
kms_plan.sh helm driver case writes plan state artifact on local profile
module_execution.sh kms local-profile driver for plan/apply/destroy is helm, not noop
